text:
Investigate elevated 5xx after deployment

Symptoms: Elevated HTTP 5xx rate; New exceptions near a release.

runbook.title: Investigate elevated 5xx after deployment
steps: Compare error rate before and after recent deployments.
Search application logs for new exception signatures and affected versions.
Check dependency metrics and logs to distinguish local and downstream failures.
If evidence supports a regression, propose rollback to the last healthy version through the normal approval process.
After mitigation, verify recovery across several metric windows.
